blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Quezon City Rep. Marvin Rillo said he is willing to drop the seven counts of cyber libel he filed against Peanut Gallery Media Network (PGMN) host CJ Hirro if she apologizes, but the accused said she has no intention of saying sorry. This came after the Quezon City Regional Trial Court Branch 20 issued a warrant of arrest against Hirro, who posted bail of P336,000 on Oct. 30. The case stemmed from two videos uploaded on seven platforms that alleged irregularities in the P71-million Carlos Albert High School gymnasium project, funded through Rillo’s office under the 2023 […]...
